{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-pa-c","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"7d178c4a980d2e74d0bbda262f2e07cbbfb54077cd6faccb17168fb5ccbccd05","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-pa-class-c:lineage:19","source_registry_sha256":"643bc755bc144bbb64c82e5b21691c27918519b2f96f9b0ff96b63899c04fddb","source_liveness_sha256":"d125293461efac0b369397a252e58fe1686ca24cdc89a306e2ea205c1feddb7c"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Warning signs","heading":"C — Warning signs","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C — Warning signs

FACT_ID: sec05-F01 | anchor: A01
Warning signs announce hazards or roadway changes ahead so drivers can respond before reaching them. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-F02 | anchor: A01
Most warning signs are diamonds with black lettering or symbols against yellow. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-F03 | anchor: A01
The NO PASSING ZONE warning is pennant-shaped and marks the zone's beginning from the left side of the road. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-F04 | anchor: A01
Chevron signs indicate a sharp roadway bend in the direction their points face. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-F05 | anchor: A01
Chevrons within a curve follow an advance curve warning, and several may appear along that curve. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-F06 | anchor: A01
At a LEFT CURVE warning, slow down and keep the vehicle centered in its lane through the bend. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-F07 | anchor: A01
At a RIGHT CURVE warning, slow down and drive slightly right of the lane's center through the bend. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-F08 | anchor: A01
A SHARP LEFT TURN warning calls for a substantial speed reduction and a centered lane position through the turn. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-F09 | anchor: A01
A SHARP RIGHT TURN warning calls for a substantial speed reduction and a position slightly right of lane center. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-F10 | anchor: A01
A sharp-turn warning may carry an advisory speed on the sign itself or on a separate sign below. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-F11 | anchor: A01
A SET OF CURVES warning announces two successive bends in opposite directions and calls for slowing before them. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-F12 | anchor: A01
A warning of successive sharp right and left turns calls for substantially reducing speed before the turns. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-F13 | anchor: A02
A WINDING ROAD warning means at least three consecutive curves are ahead. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec05-F14 | anchor: A02
A ONE DIRECTION LARGE ARROW warns of an extreme change in direction that requires slowing before the curve as for an intersection turn. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec05-F15 | anchor: A02
A ROAD ENTERING CURVE warning describes a main road bending left with a side road entering from the right. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec05-F16 | anchor: A02
At a ROAD ENTERING CURVE warning, use extra caution because an entering driver may not see traffic coming around the bend and may pull into its path. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec05-F17 | anchor: A02
A TRUCK ROLLOVER warning identifies a curve where excessive truck speed creates rollover risk. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec05-F18 | anchor: A02
An advisory-speed plaque may accompany any diamond-shaped warning sign. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec05-F19 | anchor: A02
A sharp left curve marked with a 25 mph advisory calls for a speed no greater than 25 mph on that curve. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec05-F20 | anchor: A02
A MERGING TRAFFIC warning on a major road announces traffic entering from another road or ramp. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec05-F21 | anchor: A02
Traffic entering a major roadway must yield to vehicles already traveling on it. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec05-F22 | anchor: A02
An ADDED LANE warning means joining traffic has a new lane available and does not need to merge at that point. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec05-F23 | anchor: A02
A WEAVE AREA warning means entering traffic will merge while exiting traffic crosses its path. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec05-F24 | anchor: A03
TWO-WAY TRAFFIC AHEAD warns that a one-way roadway ends and becomes two lanes carrying opposing traffic. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec05-F25 | anchor: A03
After a TWO-WAY TRAFFIC AHEAD warning, remain to the right of the centerline. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec05-F26 | anchor: A03
A LANE ENDS warning announces that a lane on a multilane road will terminate ahead. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec05-F27 | anchor: A03
When the warning specifies that the right lane ends, traffic from that lane must merge to the left. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec05-F28 | anchor: A03
Intersection warnings show how roads connect and can warn that the current roadway does not continue straight. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec05-F29 | anchor: A03
Approach warned intersections with extra caution, scanning ahead and preparing to reduce speed if needed. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec05-F30 | anchor: A03
A TWO DIRECTION LARGE ARROW on the far side of a T-intersection means the driver must choose left or right because the road does not continue straight. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec05-F31 | anchor: A03
A NARROW BRIDGE OR UNDERPASS warning means lanes narrow and a shoulder is generally absent, so reduce speed and stay within the lane. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec05-F32 | anchor: A03
At a narrow bridge or underpass, wait for an opposing vehicle to clear if it is wide or occupies part of your lane. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec05-F33 | anchor: A03
At SLIPPERY WHEN WET warnings, wet conditions call for less speed and a larger following gap. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec05-F34 | anchor: A03
On the wet slippery roadway, avoid abrupt acceleration or braking and take turns very slowly. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec05-F35 | anchor: A03
DIVIDED HIGHWAY BEGINS warns of separated opposing one-way roadways ahead and instructs traffic to keep right of the median or divider. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec05-F36 | anchor: A03
DIVIDED HIGHWAY ENDS warns of a return to two-way traffic, requiring a position right of the centerline and attention to oncoming vehicles. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0019]

Misconceptions: an added lane differs from a merge; a warning sign's advisory speed concerns the marked hazard; work-zone headlight duties apply beyond active work areas.
Mnemonics: read the hazard, choose the path and adjust speed before reaching it.
Glossary: chevrons point along a sharp change of road direction; advisory speed guides travel through the signed hazard; a weave area has entering and exiting paths that cross.
